title: Home Screen Widgets Guide
message:
• Pin your favorite sticky notes and checklists directly to your Android Home screen.
• Tap the Widget Pool icon on any note, then add the widget from your home launcher.

title: Recycle Bin 30-Day Protection
message:
• Deleted notes now stay in the Recycle Bin for 30 days before automatic cleanup.
• Restore any note back to your wall or delete it forever anytime.

title: Always Keep Backups
message:
• Tap **Export** in Settings to save all your notes, drawings, and walls into a single backup file.
• Restore everything in seconds with one tap using **Import**.

title: Organize Notes with Folders
message:
• Drag one note directly onto another to create a folder stack.
• Folders hold up to 10 notes with clean touch peel gestures and customizable titles.

title: Join Our Reddit Community
message:
• Share your creative wall setups and study boards on [r/DigitalStickyNotesApp](https://www.reddit.com/r/DigitalStickyNotesApp/)!
• Discuss feature requests and connect with fellow users worldwide.

title: Double-Tap to Quick Create
message:
• Double-tap anywhere on an empty area of your wall to instantly spawn a note right at that position.
• The fastest way to jot down fleeting ideas.

title: Distraction-Free Clean Wall View
message:
• Hide all interface controls and navigation buttons for an immersive view of your wall.
• Tap anywhere on the canvas to reveal controls again.

title: Smooth Drawing & Sketching
message:
• Draw handwritten sketches and diagrams with pressure-sensitive, anti-aliased curves.
• Switch to Art Mode for full-screen pro canvas with precision tools.

title: Interactive Checklist Notes
message:
• Create to-do lists with satisfying check-off animations and card progress counters.
• Drag to reorder items and swipe right to indent subtasks.

title: Decorative Washi Tape
message:
• Add tactile washi tape strips to your sticky notes for an authentic bulletin board feel.
• Toggle washi tape on or off anytime in Settings.

title: 100% Offline & Private
message:
• Digital Sticky Notes never collects or uploads your notes to the cloud.
• All your notes, checklists, and drawings stay strictly on your local device.

title: Palette & Wall Themes
message:
• Customize your workspace with cork, dark cork, pastel, and minimal wall themes.
• Tap the Palette icon in the menu to preview themes instantly.

title: Vintage & Handwriting Fonts
message:
• Choose between typewriter Special Elite, elegant Caveat handwriting, and clean Nunito.
• Independent font size controls ensure comfortable reading.

title: Magnetic Grid Alignment
message:
• Align notes neatly into rows and columns with magnetic snap-to-grid guides.
• Easily toggle grid snapping on and off in Settings.

title: Lock Note Position
message:
• Freeze important notes in place so they cannot be accidentally moved or dragged.
• Tap the lock icon in note options to pin the note.

title: Tactile Haptic Feedback
message:
• Feel subtle vibrations when dragging notes, checking items, and toggling settings.
• Synchronized with your Android system haptic preferences.

title: Export Notes as High-Res Images
message:
• Press and hold any note for 3 seconds in view mode to export a crisp PNG image.
• Share notes directly to messaging apps, social media, or gallery.

title: Share Your Thoughts & Ideas
message:
• Have a bug to report or a feature you want to see? Tap **Send Feedback** in Settings!
• Sends diagnostic details directly to the developer for swift fixes.

title: Available in 14 Languages
message:
• Digital Sticky Notes is translated into 14 languages worldwide!
• Tap the Globe icon in Settings anytime to switch your app language instantly.

title: Slide to Reveal Notice Delete
message:
• Keep your notices feed tidy by sliding any notice to the left.
• Tap the revealed trash icon to permanently dismiss it.

title: Checklist Progress Counters
message:
• Keep track of completed items at a glance (e.g. 4/5 done) on checklist cards.
• Celebrating icon appears once all items are completed!

title: Optimized for Tablets & Foldables
message:
• Enjoy responsive split-column layouts on Android tablets and large foldable screens.
• Expansive canvas space for extensive project boards.

title: One-Tap Date Stamp
message:
• Tap the calendar clock icon while editing to insert the current date and time.
• Perfect for meeting notes, journals, and daily logs.

title: Comfortable Dark Mode
message:
• Protect your eyes during late-night study sessions with dark cork and midnight walls.
• High contrast text ensures effortless legibility.

title: Custom Folder Cover Notes
message:
• Long-press any note inside an open folder to lock it as the folder cover anchor.
• The cover note determines the look of the closed stack.

title: Widget Pool Quick Toggle
message:
• Manage which notes sync to widgets by toggling the Widget Pool icon on card headers.
• Unsynced notes are instantly removed from home screen widgets.

title: Battery Efficient Architecture
message:
• Intelligent background throttling ensures zero idle battery drain.
• Hardware-accelerated rendering preserves maximum power.

title: Duplicate Sticky Notes
message:
• Quickly duplicate any note with matching color, font, and checklist items.
• Great for daily routines and recurring task templates.

title: Notice Notification Dots
message:
• A clean notification dot lights up on the menu whenever fresh announcements arrive.
• Clear all indicators instantly by opening the Notices panel.

title: Pro Canvas Multi-Touch Zoom
message:
• Pinch to zoom and pan across large walls with fluid gesture response.
• Work on intricate drawing details without losing your place.

title: Real-Time Auto-Save
message:
• Every keystroke and brush stroke is saved in real time to secure local storage.
• Never worry about losing drafts if the app closes.

title: Quick Share to Other Apps
message:
• Share formatted note text to WhatsApp, Telegram, email, or document apps in one tap.
• Convenient for sending quick agendas or shopping lists.

title: Daily Wellness Reminder
message:
• Take a quick break from your screen and drink a glass of water!
• Staying hydrated keeps your mind sharp and creative.

title: Follow Us on Instagram
message:
• Check out aesthetic setup inspiration on [@digitalstickynotes.app](https://www.instagram.com/digitalstickynotes.app/)!
• Tag us in your study desk setups to get featured.

title: Markdown Formatting in Notes
message:
• Use **bold** text, *italic* styling, and clickable hyperlinks in your sticky notes.
• Structure rich notes effortlessly with simple markdown syntax.

title: Empty Bin Confirmation Dialogs
message:
• Emptying the bin or deleting notes permanently always requires confirmation.
• Accidental deletions are completely prevented.

title: Warm Pastel Sticky Papers
message:
• Soft pastel colors including honey yellow, sage green, lavender, sky blue, and peach.
• Specially calibrated for high text contrast in daylight.

title: Silky 90Hz & 120Hz Animation
message:
• Optimized for high refresh rate displays on modern Android devices.
• Note sliding and physics toss gestures feel exceptionally smooth.

title: Transparent Widget Themes
message:
• Blend home screen widgets seamlessly into your device wallpaper.
• Toggle transparent widget background mode in Settings.

title: Interactive In-App User Guide
message:
• New to Digital Sticky Notes? Open the User Guide from Settings anytime.
• Visual walkthroughs for gestures, stacking, widgets, and backups.

title: Nested Checklist Subtasks
message:
• Break larger tasks into smaller achievable milestones with subtasks.
• Check off individual subtasks while tracking master task progress.

title: Tactile Note Rotation Angles
message:
• Loose sticky notes sit with subtle natural rotation angles on your canvas wall.
• Gives your digital wall the organic charm of physical paper.

title: Preview Notes in Recycle Bin
message:
• Tap any note in the Recycle Bin to view its full text, drawings, and checklists.
• Inspect content thoroughly before choosing to Restore or Delete Forever.

title: Seamless Device Migration
message:
• Switching to a new phone? Export your wall backup and transfer the .json file.
• Import on your new device to restore all notes, folders, and widgets intact.

title: Drawing Eraser & Undo Steps
message:
• Draw confidently with up to 50 levels of undo and redo in Art Mode.
• Precision eraser allows correcting fine details without clearing sketches.

title: Dilute Stacks Unlink Shortcut
message:
• Need to unpack all folders at once? Use the Dilute Stacks action in Settings.
• Safely unpacks all folders into loose notes without deleting any content.

title: Lightweight Memory Footprint
message:
• Clean architecture keeps memory footprint minimal even with dozens of active notes.
• Instant startup and fast canvas resumption.

title: Transparent Privacy Policy
message:
• Our privacy policy is 100% public, readable, and verified for Google Play standards.
• View it anytime from Settings or at our official privacy policy website.

title: Welcome to Digital Sticky Notes!
message:
• Thank you for choosing Digital Sticky Notes to organize your life and ideas!
• We are constantly refining the app based on your feedback.

title: 2.7.5 Updates
message:
• Now, you can receive in-app updates! Like this.
• Added **Send Feedback** button in Settings.
• Join our [Reddit community](https://www.reddit.com/r/DigitalStickyNotesApp/)!
• Now your deleted notes are safe for some time in the Recycle Bin.
